items.title: File Widerspruch against Gefahrklassen assessment
items.quote: Den Widerspruch können Sie binnen eines Monats ab Bekanntgabe einlegen, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Musterbau-Berufsgenossenschaft, Gerüstweg 7, 30159 Musterhannover.
items.computation: The Bescheid is dated 19.11.2026 (Thursday); the letter itself states the deemed-delivery rule: 'Als bekannt gegeben gilt der Bescheid am vierten Tag nach seiner Aufgabe zur Post.' No separate 'zur Post gegeben am' date is given, so the document date (19.11.2026) is the posting day. Berufsgenossenschaften are social-law bodies (SGB X/SGB VII), so the 4th-day delivery fiction does not move even onto a weekend/holiday. Counting 4 calendar days after 19.11.2026 (the posting day itself not counted): 20, 21, 22, 23 -> delivery = 23.11.2026 (Monday, a working day anyway, no shift needed). The one-month Widerspruch period runs from delivery per § 26 SGB X with §§ 187, 188 BGB counting: the period ends on the day in the following month bearing the same number as the delivery day, i.e. 23.12.2026. 23.12.2026 is a Wednesday and not a public holiday in NW, so no shift under § 26 Abs. 3 SGB X is needed.
